    triangle_type: str,
    side_lengths: tuple[float, float],
) -> list[list[float]]:
    """Get the vertices of a triangle given its type and side lengths."""

    vertices = []
    if triangle_type == "equilateral":
        side = side_lengths[0]
        height = (np.sqrt(3) / 2) * side
        v0 = [-side / 2, -height / 3, 0]
        v1 = [side / 2, -height / 3, 0]
        v2 = [0, 2 * height / 3, 0]
        vertices = [v0, v1, v2]
    elif triangle_type == "isosceles":
        base = side_lengths[0]
        height = side_lengths[1]
        v0 = [-base / 2, 0, 0]
        v1 = [base / 2, 0, 0]
        v2 = [0, height, 0]
        vertices = [v0, v1, v2]
    elif triangle_type == "right":
        base = side_lengths[0]
        height = side_lengths[1]
        v0 = [0, 0, 0]
        v1 = [base, 0, 0]
        v2 = [0, height, 0]
        vertices = [v0, v1, v2]
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown triangle type: {triangle_type}")

    return vertices
